t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pay attention to which gnome brings you to the better forest and keep in mind that how good a gnome is can change throughout the game.

vb_textbox.text: There are four pairs of gnomes, Pink and Green, Blue and Purple, Yellow and Red, and Orange and Brown. One gnome in the pair will result in more mushrooms, though which gnome that is will change randomly throughout the game. When a pair of gnomes changes which gnome is better, it seems to change which one is better in every pair, though I'm not completely confident about that.
